programs.title: The Proof Is Out There: Bermuda Triangle Edition
programs.desc: Tony Harris travels to the Florida coast to investigate the legendary Bermuda beast and other mysterious sea creatures at the Bermuda Triangle; Tony and a team of experts will analyze evidence of similar bizarre sea creatures from around the world.

programs.title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
programs.desc: From a piece of the International Space Station crashing into a Florida home, to the first chimpanzee blasted into space, to a mind-bending time slip experienced by two women in Versailles, this episode dives into the unbelievable stories that challenge what we think we know about our place in the universe.

programs.title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
programs.desc: How did a pet pig spring into action to save its owner's life? Which mysterious spirits became the unlikely heroes that turned the tide for a doomed flight? And what shocking move did a carjacker make to rescue a baby trapped in a scorching car? These are the wild, unexpected stories of heroes you'd never see coming.

programs.title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
programs.desc: Weapons rank among humanity's most powerful-and wildest-inventions; some unleash mass destruction, while others are downright bizarre; from launching corpses with trebuchets, to turning animals into killing machines, and missiles guided by pigeons, these are the stories behind history's most outrageous weapons.

programs.title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
programs.desc: History is full of miracle cures, far-fetched products, and astonishing feats, but not all of them are legitimate; a miracle snake oil that cures all? A piece of the Brooklyn Bridge for sale? A marathon-winner who crosses the finish line without hardly breaking a sweat? These are the stories of some of history's most spectacular cons, each deception more unbelievable than the last.

programs.title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
programs.desc: A drilling accident tears open the Earth and unleashes a fire pit known as the "Gates of Hell"; a routine flight turns harrowing when the pilot gets sucked out of the cockpit midair; a ship mishap sinks 4,000 luxury cars into the Atlantic.
